title: Run the SpecSync archive gate before every CI job
description: Run the SpecSync archive gate before every CI job
no_spec_change_rationale: CI workflow ordering only; no canonical spec owns .github/workflows
acceptance_criteria: ci.yml and spec-sync.yml each start with a job named Archive that runs the archive gate through CorvidLabs/spec-sync pinned at 106aaa43d0bcf049f19b173ddb63815a25c3f931 with archive-gate-only, and every other job in those workflows needs it, so a pull request with an open SpecSync change runs nothing else until the change is archived
